manifest.name: Music
manifest.description: Configuration of the core music (library) management module

default_genres.label: Use the built-in genre catalog
default_genres.description: Music Assistant ships with a curated list of genres and their aliases, and folds the genres it finds in your tags into it (a track tagged 'Rap' is filed under Hip-Hop). Turn this off to keep the catalog out of your library and let your own tags stand on their own.

tag_genres_as_main.label: Import genres from tags as main genres
tag_genres_as_main.description: Import every genre name found in your tags as a genre in its own right, instead of merging it into the genre that lists it as an alias. Existing genre mappings are left alone; only new scans and syncs are affected.

reset_db.label: Reset library database
reset_db.description: This will issue a full reset of the library database and trigger a full sync. Only use this option as a last resort if you are seeing issues with the library database.
